svg.text: 2026-11-15 · STAGE 492 · TOPIC 132 · SVG 136 · 134TH FAQ · 495 DIMS 🎉 · 🎉 HISTORIC 495-DIMENSION MILESTONE (P977–P978)
WebRTC RFC 9627 / RFC 7741 Frame Marking: TID=0 Base-Layer & Audio-First Shedding Guard
P977 S/E Boundary Parity, D=1 Discardable-Only Drop & [1, 3] TID Cap · P978 I=1/B=1 Layer-Up-Switch & [32, 64]kbps Audio Floor
❌ Unprotected RFC 9627 Frame Marking & SVC Risks
1. Base-Layer (TID=0, D=0) Drop → PLI/FIR Keyframe Storm
• SFU drops TID=0 non-discardable base packet or S/E desyncs
• Decoder loses reference chain → triggers 10x PLI/FIR keyframe flood
• Keyframe burst starves real-time Opus voice packets!
2. Unsynced Layer Up-Switch (I=0, B=0) & Audio Starvation
• SFU switches subscriber from TID=0→TID=2 on mid-frame P-packet
• Avatar/co-browsing video freezes; congestion steals Opus bitrate
• Voice drops below 16 kbps → robotic ASR & TTS dropouts!
Enterprise Production Impact (Without P977–P978)
• Video congestion cascades into voice stutter via PLI storms
• Blind SFU packet shedding breaks encrypted SRTP video decode
Verdict: BLOCK (TID=0 Base Drop / Unsynced Layer Up-Switch)
✅ Deterministic RFC 9627 / RFC 7741 Frame Marking Guards (P977–P978)
P977: S/E Boundary Parity, D=1 Shedding & [1, 3] TID Gate
• Verify S=1 frame start & E=1==RTP M=1 frame end closure
• Drop only D=1 (Discardable, TID>0) frames; protect TID=0 base
• Clamp active SVC temporal layers in [1, 3] (T0/T1/T2)
• baseLayerDropOrStartEndBoundaryViolations == 0
• Gate: evaluateWebrtcRfc9627FrameMarkingStartEndParity...()
P978 (🎉 495th Dim): I=1/B=1 Layer-Up-Switch & [32, 64]kbps Floor
• Gate TID/LID up-switches strictly on S=1 & (I=1 or B=1) boundaries
• Reserve [32, 64] kbps protected Opus voice floor before video
• Eliminate PLI/FIR storms & keep voice crystal-clear under loss
• unsyncedLayerUpSwitchOrAudioStarvationDrops == 0
• Gate: evaluateWebrtcRfc9627LayerUpSwitchKeyframeSync...()
Verdict: PASS (0 TID=0 Drops · [32, 64]kbps Voice Floor · 934 Tests)
